newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Feb 11.
newsitem.headline: Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Feb 11.

text.p: Some Australian stocks to watch this morning:
Bionic ear maker due to report half year results. Previous corresponding half saw net profit of A$5.13 million.
Contract miner due to report half year results. Previous corresponding half saw net profit of A$9.45 million.
Victorian-based regional bank due to report half year results. Previous corresponding half saw a net profit of A$44.57 million.

Events unfold in Optus Vision pay TV saga with Seven network saying late on monday it had received two offers to enable it to acquire all the shares in Optus Vision, one for A$678.74 million and one for A$533.80 million. Both offers are pending the outcome of legal action.
Resource leader said on Monday it had agreed to sell its Greenhil petroleum subsidiary to Mesa Operating Co for a price of US$270.5 million.
On Monday, big beer group posted a 13 percent pre-tax operating profit of A$184.8 million for the six months to December 31.
